content.title: Chapter 70 - PERSONNEL RULES — Sec. 70-186.2. - Rehire status.
content.summary:
Employees who are separated by layoff are entitled to apply for future job vacancies
               in the same manner as an internal candidate for up to one year from the date of the
               layoff. Employees rehired after a layoff will be rehired pursuant to
section 70-39
.
(
Ord. No. 4862
…
